name: Stratified LD score regression
model_likelihood: Additive linear phenotype model y=X beta+epsilon with standardized genotypes and mean-zero noise; expected marginal chi-square statistics linear in category LD scores
prior: Independent mean-zero random effects with Var(beta_j)=sum of tau_c over categories containing j; conditional iid effect assumption
inference_algorithm: Multiple regression of marginal chi-square statistics on category LD scores; block jackknife for coefficient covariance and standard errors
estimand: Annotation variance coefficients tau_c; category SNP-heritability approximated by summed effect variances; category enrichment relative to SNP proportion
data_input: GWAS marginal chi-square summary statistics and category-specific LD scores from in-sample LD or a population-matched external reference panel
tunable_settings: Included functional annotation categories; jackknife block count (200 used)
